zh.text: 今天唯一的一線希望是債券終於作為分散投資工具發揮作用（可能因為這次拋售不全是利率問題）。$TLT上漲1.3%，$AGG上漲0.62%，$LQD上漲0.59%。不多但總比過去幾年常與股票一起下跌好。不過$TLT五年圖表上有很多眼淚和損失。

en.text: If there's one silver lining today it's that bonds finally 'worked' as a diversifier (prob bc this selloff wasn't all about rates). $TLT up 1.3%, $AGG up 0.62%, $LQD up 0.59%. Not a lot but hey you'll take it bc a lot of times they go down with stocks past few years. All that said, here's $TLT 5-year chart. Lot of tears and lost cash in that chart.

zh.text: 標普 500 $SPX 相當緊密地追蹤 1978 年類比。那也是中期選舉年、通脹復蘇時期，以及馬年。

en.text: The S&P 500 $SPX is tracking 1978 analog pretty closely. It was also a mid term year, period of resurgent inflation, and also the year of the horse.

zh.text: damnang2 發帖稱終於發生了，引用 $QCOM 裁減超過 500 名加州員工及超過 1000 名印度員工的新聞，預期 Google 與 Microsoft 將跟進，並對股權下跌及失業的員工表示遺憾。 $QCOM

en.text: damnang2 posts Finally it happened quoting that $QCOM lays off over 500 California employees and over 1000 in India, expecting Google and Microsoft to follow, noting sadness for employees with down equities and lost jobs. $QCOM

zh.text: 當預期再次開始轉變時會變得有趣。什麼時候任何計算建設（如雲端）會這樣見頂？

en.text: It’s going to get interesting when expectations start to shift again. Since when does any compute build out (like cloud) peak like this?

zh.text: 我本可以從 $JOJO 走開十幾次。債券市場給了我每一個理由。我沒有。因為這是信用輪動最重要的週期。

en.text: I could have walked away from $JOJO a dozen times. The bond market gave me every reason to. I didn't. Because this is the cycle where credit rotation matters most.

zh.text: 日圓套利交易解除期間（2024年7月16日至8月5日，Credit-off 3週中的4週，實時）：JOJO.Index +6.26%，長期國債 +5.27%，高收益 -0.85%，標普500 -8.41%。

en.text: When the yen carry trade unwound (Credit-off 3 of 4 weeks, Jul 16 to Aug 5, 2024, live): JOJO.Index +6.26%, Long Treasuries +5.27%, High yield -0.85%, S&P 500 -8.41%.

zh.text: 美國化石燃料利益在川普缺席的 COP 上成為焦點 – Politico。

en.text: U.S. fossil fuel interests take the spotlight at COP in Trump’s absence – Politico.

zh.text: @KawzInvests 警告新雲端投資者，根據 @silicondata CEO 估計，約 20% GPU 租賃需求來自中國透過遠端離岸管道，但 11 月 16 日 BIS 關閉後門，以防止透過第三國數據中心規避美國技術限制。中國現已被切斷遠端租賃，美國國內需求必須吸收該供應。提及 $NBIS $CRWV。引用關於如果中國需求消失，計算價格是否可能崩潰的討論。

en.text: @KawzInvests warns neocloud investors that ~20% of GPU rental demand came from China via remote offshore channels per @silicondata CEO, but BIS on Nov 16 shut the backdoor to prevent circumvention of US tech restrictions through third-country data centers. China now cut off from remote leasing, so US domestic demand must absorb the supply. Mentions $NBIS $CRWV. Quoted discussion on whether compute prices could crash if China demand disappears.

en.text: I think short term trader positioning is now bullish for the market. What bothers me is that the passive/index crowd has not budged. This was published by BAC on Nov 19.
